## Names

<a id="irq_frame_start"></a>
### [`irq_frame_start`](../../../../src/irq/sprite_mux_plan.asm#L6) `$2A66`

*routine*

Raster IRQ at line 0, the start of the sprite multiplexer. It acknowledges the VIC, sets the next IRQ to $2869 at line $5a and sets the sprite multicolours. It puts front_fighter in group A (sprites 0-2, in front) and the other fighter in group B (sprites 3-5). It selects the shadow handler, patches the row handlers for one of 7 layouts, sets sprite row 1 and returns with RTI.

<a id="mux_choose_layout"></a>
### [`mux_choose_layout`](../../../../src/irq/sprite_mux_plan.asm#L104) `$2B40`

*label*

Selects one of 7 layouts from the Y gap between group A ($1c) and group B ($1d). Sprite Y is fighter_y*2 and all script dy values are even, thus the gap is a multiple of 4. Of these gaps, only $14 puts two row IRQs one raster line apart; it gets a combined handler.

- **Jumped to from:** [`irq_frame_start`](sprite_mux_plan.md#irq_frame_start) [`$2AFD`](../../../../src/irq/sprite_mux_plan.asm#L74)

<a id="mux_set_row1"></a>
### [`mux_set_row1`](../../../../src/irq/sprite_mux_plan.asm#L485) `$2E5A`

*label*

Sets sprite row 1 of both groups: pointers $cff8-$cffd from parts 0-2, Y and colours. X is group X +0, +$18 and +$30, with X bit 8 from mux_msb_bits_a/b. Then it restores X, Y and A and returns from the IRQ.
